definitions.gloss: recent years; in recent years; lately
definitions.explanation: Refers to the past several years up to the present, used to introduce trends or changes that have emerged over a period of time.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, the number of tourists has been increasing.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}→技術革新：12892_gijutsukakushin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}ましい→目覚ましい：13628_mezamashii⟧。
examples.english: Technological innovation in recent years has been remarkable.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、⟦{異常気象|いじょうきしょう}→異常気象：18874_ijoukishou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界各地|せかいかくち}→世界各地：24526_sekaikakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧になっている。
examples.english: In recent years, damage from extreme weather has become severe in various parts of the world.

notes:
Compound of {近|きん} (near, recent) + ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year). Typically refers to a span of roughly 5-10 years. More formal than ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧, which can mean "recently" on any timescale.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近年|きんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (recent trends)
- {近年|きんねん}まれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (rarely seen in recent years)
- {近年|きんねん}⟦{急増|きゅうぞう}している→急増する：26999_kyuuzousuru⟧ (rapidly increasing in recent years)

USAGE:
Often appears at the beginning of sentences to set a temporal frame. Primarily a written or formal-speech word. In casual conversation, ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧ or ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧ are preferred.
